reason: V3-06 repair. Candidate delta adds domain services (syncEngine, invitationService, unitChangeService, authorizationRules, costInstrumentation), sync state tables, and a 731-line test suite. The existing domain services and cursor design are a sound WIP baseline; the next cycle must wire the sync pipeline end-to-end, add the two missing UI flows, enforce authorization in the data path, and extend tests to prove business-level effects.
